items.html: And behold, the milk that is drawn to the two breasts is through the letter Hei of Elokim that is between them, which becomes the channel of the milk that pours in the middle, to the two breasts, and expands to this side and to that side, in the secret of the Tifferet that decides between the two of them. And it is known that the milk is not equal in one aspect, for the milk drawn into the right breast will be sweeter than the milk drawn into the left breast.
